I have completed the independent review of the room booking application and written the release verdict to [REVIEW.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-9M80hM/workspace/REVIEW.md). The product source code and existing files were not modified.

### Summary of What Was Verified

1. **Product Acceptance Suite**: Executed `accept-check.js` in strict independent acceptor mode. The automated gate returned **BLOCK**.
2. **Unit Test Suite**: Executed `npm test`. All 9 unit tests passed across [validate.test.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-9M80hM/workspace/test/validate.test.js) and [bookings.test.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-9M80hM/workspace/test/bookings.test.js).
3. **Frontend & UX Inspection**: Examined [public/index.html](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-9M80hM/workspace/public/index.html) and [src/server.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-9M80hM/workspace/src/server.js). Found that no user interface exists (only an empty HTML shell without scripts or styles) and static file serving is not configured on the Express app.
4. **Calendar Master Service Integration**: Inspected [src/calendar.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-9M80hM/workspace/src/calendar.js) and confirmed `roomsOutOfService()` is unintegrated/uncalled by any server or booking logic, violating the constraint that the calendar service masters availability.
5. **Operability & Architecture**: Verified missing `/health` monitoring endpoints, lack of operational documentation, and missing trust boundary documentation in [ARCHITECTURE.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-9M80hM/workspace/ARCHITECTURE.md).

**Release Verdict:** **BLOCK** — Do not replace paper door sheets on Monday until the UI is built, calendar integration is connected, and operability requirements are met.
